metadata.target_definition: 1 when Time_taken(min) > configured SLA (30 minutes); otherwise 0.

feature_availability_policy.delivery_distance_km: Included only when store and customer coordinates are available at order placement; invalid regional coordinate pairs are missing.
feature_availability_policy.order_hour: Included when the order time is available at order placement.
feature_availability_policy.order_day: Included: derived from the order date.
feature_availability_policy.day_of_week: Included: derived from the order date.
feature_availability_policy.is_weekend: Included: derived from the order date.
feature_availability_policy.is_peak_hour: Included: configured time-window heuristic derived from order time.
feature_availability_policy.distance_band: Included: derived from validated store-to-customer distance.
feature_availability_policy.City: Included: destination city is part of order information.
feature_availability_policy.Type_of_order: Included: order category is known from the submitted order.
feature_availability_policy.weather_normalized: Excluded: dataset does not establish that weather is available at placement.
feature_availability_policy.traffic_normalized: Excluded: dataset does not establish that traffic is available at placement.
feature_availability_policy.Festival: Excluded: dataset does not establish schedule availability at placement.
feature_availability_policy.Delivery_person_ID: Excluded: rider assignment timing is unknown.
feature_availability_policy.Delivery_person_Age: Excluded: rider assignment timing is unknown.
feature_availability_policy.Delivery_person_Ratings: Excluded: rating availability/assignment timing is unknown.
feature_availability_policy.Vehicle_condition: Excluded: vehicle assignment timing is unknown.
feature_availability_policy.Type_of_vehicle: Excluded: vehicle assignment timing is unknown.
feature_availability_policy.is_late_order: Excluded: derived from the delivery-time target.

excluded_prediction_fields.Time_taken(min): Outcome used only to construct the label.
excluded_prediction_fields.weather_normalized/Road_traffic_density: Availability at order placement is unverified; included only as retrospective dashboard context, never as model features.

metadata.prediction_scenario: Order placement. Rider-assignment and post-pickup models are not combined.

training_configuration.threshold_selection: Maximize F2 on the stratified training validation split, with precision/intervention-volume tie breaks.
training_configuration.resampling: None. Class-weight options are compared during model tuning; synthetic resampling is not used.
training_configuration.preprocessing_fit_scope: Imputation, encoding, scaling, and calibration are fit within training folds or the training partition only.

decision_costs.status: No monetary/operational cost values were provided.
decision_costs.threshold_policy: Maximize F2 on training-only validation; this prioritizes recall without inventing costs.

validation_calibration.interpretation: Reliability is estimated on a held-out training validation set. It is not a guarantee of calibration in production.

test_calibration.interpretation: Reliability is estimated on a held-out training validation set. It is not a guarantee of calibration in production.

interpretation: False negatives are genuinely late orders not flagged; false positives are on-time orders unnecessarily flagged. Feature importance and category breakdowns describe associations, not causes. Weather and traffic fields are retrospective context only, not classifier inputs.
